title: Moomin House design parameters
description: source/config.json drives every part, placement, cut sheet and book page. Lengths are millimetres, angles degrees. Check a config with: python source/config_check.py

facet.description: A wall facet position, W01-W12. W01 faces -75 degrees, then +30 degrees per facet.

height.description: Leaf height along the hinge axis

axis_offset.description: Hinge axis outside the tower's corner radius

hole_x.description: Screw-hole distance from the hinge axis

hole_y.description: Screw-hole positions up the leaf, from its bottom edge

centers.description: Hinge centres: wall hinges up from the ground-floor top, door hinges up from the bottom of the door

packing_thickness.description: Rigid shim under each wall-hinge leaf

count.description: How many primary sheets may be used before extra boards

existing.description: The primary sheets are already owned (marked 'existing' in the stock list)

extra.description: Board sizes to buy for parts that do not fit the primary sheets; the smallest that fits is chosen

stock_set.description: Plywood available per thickness. Keys are thicknesses in mm: 8, 6, 4 or 3.

height.description: Finished height including the finial. The roof takes up any change above the walls.

plinth.description: Stone plinth between the base and the ground floor, with the hidden drawer

height.description: From the top of the base to the top of the ground floor

apothem.description: Centre to the outside of a plinth panel (half the across-flats width)

direction.description: Direction the drawer slides out, degrees in plan (180 = to the left)

back.description: Position of the drawer back along the slide direction

travel.description: How far the drawer pulls out (checked clear)

partition.description: One room divider per storey along the house axis

front_gap.description: Clearance between the divider's front edge and the closing walls

levels.description: Which figure stands on each storey, ground floor first (the attic is the fourth)

turn.description: Degrees each figure turns toward the middle of the house

heights.description: Finished height of each figure, feet to top of head or hat, mm

door_clearance.description: [width, height] every figure must have to spare in every doorway, mm

density.description: g/cm3; weigh a block of your own clay

block.description: Grams per clay block in the shop

foil_wall.description: Clay thickness over a foil core

tower_diameter.description: Across the vertices of the 12-sided tower

roof_diameter.description: Roof eave diameter; must exceed the tower diameter

floor.description: Ground, intermediate and attic floor plywood thickness

nest_spacing.description: Minimum gap between parts on a jigsaw sheet

laser.description: Sheets of this thickness are laid out for a laser cutter

a4_window.description: Usable area on an A4 laser sheet: [x0, y0, x1, y1]

stock_margin.description: Unused border at every sheet edge

starter_diameter.description: Jigsaw starter hole drilled in the waste of each opening

wall_hinge.description: Hinges of the two opening wall shells. Measure your real hinges.

door_hinge.description: Hinges of the two entrance doors

magnets.description: Neodymium disc magnets (axially magnetised) and the plain steel discs they hold, for the wall catches and stops

pocket.description: [diameter, depth] of the blind hole a magnet is bedded in, 0.5 mm deeper than the magnet

disc.description: [diameter, thickness] of each steel counter disc

disc_pocket.description: [diameter, depth] of the recess a steel disc is bedded in

wall_catch.description: Solid-wood block inside each opening shell, just under the attic floor: a magnet in F02 holds the shell shut

block.description: [length along the wall, depth into the room, thickness] in mm

x.description: Distance from the front closing seam to the block

gap.description: Air gap between the block top and the attic floor

wall_stop.description: Garden post on the base that stops each opening shell and holds it open with a magnet

angle.description: Opening angle where a shell meets its post, degrees; also the open angle of the renders, the viewer and the wall-swing check

top.description: Post top above the ground-floor top

contact_x.description: Contact point on the hinge facet, from its end away from the hinge

gap.description: Gap between the opened shell and the post face

thickness_tolerance.description: Measured-thickness band per nominal plywood thickness for source/thickness_check.py: [minus, plus] mm

veranda.description: Facet with the veranda door; must be the veranda's facet

facet.description: The fixed wall facet the veranda stands against

depth.description: Deck depth away from the wall

permanent.description: The veranda is glued on permanently (the only option the model builds)

optional.description: Plywood for the optional furniture, never shared with the house

supplier.description: Document-only supplier defaults. Null tolerances await supplier confirmation; CAD thickness stress-test allowances are not manufacturing tolerances.

maximum_sheet_mm.description: Published Mika-Tech laser envelope; other suppliers must confirm their own capacity. Sheets may be rotated.

stock_sizes_mm.description: Required one-piece blank formats, available as retail 3 mm plywood. Supplier stock availability remains subject to confirmation.

colors.description: Palette used by the CAD, renders, viewer and book. The model refers to these names.
